_about: Emergency fast path (docs/hazard-and-services.md section 7). must_fire: someone in danger now (some phrased outside the phrase list, for the classifier); must_not: ordinary health, budget, statistics and hazard questions, some containing an emergency word inside a data question. Our own test sentences, no user data. Run: uv run python evals/emergency/run.py
